items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He said, Cozy (Caucsey?) been with us seven years. I said, man, I don't care how long he's been with you. I said, I want the same amount of money that Cozy (Caucsey?) gets.

ctx.x: And he never did hire Zutty.

That's what he told me. He said, Cozy (Caucsey?) been with us seven years. I said, man, I don't care how long he's been with you. I said, I want the same amount of money that Cozy (Caucsey?) gets. (LAUGHTER).
Because Zutty wasn't worried, he was doing alright.
